title: ArrangeOutput
description: `arrange` role output (§9, §13): the episode's scenes in chapters, each chapter's scenes in narration order (a scene moved earlier or later = flashback, in medias res), cuts between chapters only. The server requires every scene exactly once and rescales each chapter's target_chars to sum to the chapter's target, keeping the model's proportions.

scenes.description: In narration order; the chapter is cut after its last scene, on a hook.

scene.description: The scene's story-order number (narrowed per call to 1..n).

target_chars.description: The scene's share of its chapter in characters (a proportion: the server rescales).

reveal.description: What the scene reveals to the reader, possibly nothing.
